name: Melee PC
game: Super Smash Bros. Melee (GameCube, USA revision 2)
notes: Personal source build of 999sian/melee-pc 0.4.2 with the save-creation fix. Build locally on an Apple Silicon Mac or with GitHub Cloud Build in a private repository. LiveContainer confirmation pending.

steps: In your existing LiveContainer setup, tap + and select {file}; use a fresh data container for this save test and keep the existing app and saves intact. Alternatively, install the IPA normally with your own signing tool.
In Melee, tap Choose Disc and pick your own USA revision 2 (NTSC-U 1.02) disc image from Files.
Choose Yes to create Game Data. Change Options → Sound → music/sound balance, return to the main menu, then restart the game and check that the setting persists.
The app identifies itself as Melee PC 0.4.2, build 54. Keep this personal IPA private. LiveContainer compatibility still needs confirmation; follow the linked setup guide.

off_mac.text: Build Melee PC for iPhone/iPad on GitHub’s hosted Mac from your browser. Use a private copy of PadMint so the personal IPA stays private. Follow the guide to import the repository, run the melee-pc workflow and download your IPA. Your disc stays on your device. GitHub Actions usage limits apply.
